tickets.title: Export the invoice list as CSV
tickets.outcome: An accountant can download all invoices for a chosen month as a CSV file.
acceptance_criteria: Given 40 invoices in March, when the user clicks Export CSV for March, then a file with 40 data rows and one header row downloads.
Given a month with no invoices, when the user clicks Export CSV, then a file with only the header row downloads.
definition_of_done: Column order documented in the help page

tickets.title: Add an Export CSV button to the invoice page
tickets.outcome: The invoice list page exposes the export so users can find it.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with the Accountant role, when they open the invoice list, then an Export CSV button is visible above the table.
Given a user without the Accountant role, when they open the invoice list, then no Export CSV button is shown.
definition_of_done: Visual check on desktop and mobile widths
